# Doc Diff

> Doc Diff is a free, open-source (MIT) web app that compares two versions of a document (PDF with a text layer, Word .docx, or plain text) and marks every changed word. It runs entirely in the browser: the files are not uploaded, and the page's Content Security Policy (`connect-src 'none'`) makes the browser block every network connection from the page. No account, no ads, no tracking, no cookies. The interface is in German and English.

Typical use: you have an old and a new version of a contract, tender, offer or other text and want to see exactly what changed, without sending the documents to a third-party server. Removed text is shown struck through in red, added text in green. The result can be exported as a Word .docx file with tracked changes, as PDF (print), as an HTML or Markdown report, or as plain text.

Limits: no OCR (scanned PDFs without a text layer are rejected), no legacy .doc or .rtf, formatting (bold, fonts, table layout, images) is not compared, multi-column PDF layouts can come out in the wrong reading order, and a paragraph that was both moved and edited shows as a deletion plus an insertion. It is not a legal review tool.

## App

- [Doc Diff, German page](https://docdiff.app/): the app; German is the default, the interface switches to English for English-language browsers and has a DE / EN toggle
- [Doc Diff, English page](https://docdiff.app/en/): the same app, starting in English
- [Offline version (DocDiff.html)](https://github.com/tschnorpfeil/docdiff/raw/main/DocDiff.html): the whole app as a single HTML file of just under 3 MB; open it from disk, no installation and no internet needed
